meta.title: RightKit：让访达的右键菜单更好用
meta.description: RightKit 给访达的右键菜单加上新建文件、拷贝到、移动到、用应用打开和 16 个文件工具。免费、开源，适用于 macOS 26。

hero.lead: RightKit 给访达的右键菜单加上新建文件、拷贝到、移动到、用应用打开和一整套文件工具。
hero.requirement: 免费 · 需要 macOS 26 或更高版本
hero.charAlt: RightKit 的角色 Riko 伸手点向右键菜单，肩上趴着一只小白鼠

profile.name: Riko
profile.body: 开朗、手快、靠得住的右键小帮手。珊瑚色头发、卷起的呆毛，还有那枚光标菜单发卡，是她最显眼的标记。肩上的小白鼠只有右边一只耳朵是珊瑚色。

new.label: 新建
new.title: 在哪里右键，就在哪里新建。
new.body: 文本、Markdown、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、JSON、Shell 脚本等 12 种类型，也可以把任意文件存成自己的模板。重名自动编号，从不覆盖。

send.title: 常用的文件夹，一步就到。
send.body: 「复制到」和「移动到」直接列出你设定的目标文件夹，「常用目录」一键在访达里打开。文件多、体积大时显示进度，随时可以取消。

open.title: 直接在终端或编辑器里打开。
open.body: 终端打开所在的目录，编辑器打开项目本身。首次启动会自动找到终端、Ghostty、Visual Studio Code 和 Xcode，也可以添加任何应用。

toolbox.label: 工具箱
toolbox.title: 16 个小工具，收在一个子菜单里。
toolbox.body: 只显示和当前选择有关的命令：选图片时出现转换和图标集，选文件夹时出现解散文件夹。每个命令都可以关掉或重新排序。

trust.label: 放心用
trust.title: 右键很快，也很稳。
trust.body: 右键菜单很容易误点，所以 RightKit 在关键的地方多想了一步。

items.body: 「彻底删除」不经过废纸篓，所以默认先弹确认，而且没有默认按钮。

items.title: 系统目录受保护

items.title: 从不覆盖

items.title: 进度可以取消

items.title: 只在你指定的地方出现

items.title: 在本机完成
items.body: 文件操作都在你的 Mac 上进行，二维码也在本机生成。

items.title: 快捷指令与聚焦
items.body: 拷贝路径、新建文件、文件哈希、转换图片、生成图标集等动作可以放进快捷指令。

items.title: 二维码

items.title: 翻译

faq.label: 常见问题
faq.title: 常见问题

items.a: 官网版免费，全部功能都能用，源代码在 GitHub 公开。Mac App Store 上的商店版售价 1 美元，功能相同，由 App Store 负责更新，购买就是对开发的支持。
macOS 26 或更高版本。RightKit 按 macOS 26 的原生界面设计，不支持更早的系统。

items.q: 装好以后右键菜单里没有 RightKit？
items.a: 打开「系统设置 > 通用 > 登录项与扩展」，启用 RightKit 的访达扩展。RightKit 的设置窗口也会显示扩展当前的状态。

items.q: 为什么有些文件夹里没有菜单？
items.a: 菜单只在你授权的文件夹里出现。首次启动时建议授权主目录，之后可以在设置的「通用」里修改。
不会。所有文件操作都在你的 Mac 上完成。只有在你主动使用「翻译」时，选中的文字会发送到你选择的翻译网站。
彻底删除不经过废纸篓，所以默认先弹确认。系统目录和你的主目录受到保护，不能通过 RightKit 删除。

items.q: 能添加自己的文件模板吗？
items.a: 可以。在设置的「新建文件」里把任意文件添加为模板，RightKit 会保存一份副本。
简体中文和英文，默认跟随系统，也可以在设置里切换。

privacy.title: 隐私政策
privacy.updated: 最后更新：2026 年 9 月 25 日
privacy.intro: RightKit 不收集、不存储、也不上传你的任何个人数据。没有账号、广告和使用统计。

sections.title: 你的文件
body: 新建、拷贝、移动、转换图片、计算哈希等操作都在你的 Mac 上完成，文件不会离开本机。RightKit 运行在 App Sandbox 里，只能访问你授权的文件夹。

sections.title: 设置
body: 模板、常用目录和各项开关只保存在本机。卸载 RightKit 时可以一并删除。

sections.title: 二维码
body: 二维码在本机生成，文本不会上传。

sections.title: 翻译
body: 使用「使用 Google 翻译」或「使用百度翻译」时，RightKit 会把你选中的文本放进网址，用默认浏览器打开对应的翻译网站。文本由浏览器发给该网站，适用该网站的隐私政策。RightKit 本身不发送也不保存这段文本。

sections.title: 检查更新（仅官网版）
body: 官网版会向 GitHub 查询最新版本号。这次请求不带任何个人信息，但 GitHub 会像处理普通网页访问一样看到你的 IP 地址。可以在设置里关闭自动检查更新。App Store 版不做这个请求，由 App Store 负责更新。

sections.title: 本网站
body: 本网站是静态页面，不使用 Cookie，也没有统计和追踪脚本。托管服务商可能为了安全和运维记录常规访问日志。

sections.title: 变更和联系
body: 本政策如有变更，会更新这个页面和上面的日期。有任何问题，请发邮件到 contact@yiliang.me。

meta.title: RightKit: a better right-click menu for Finder
meta.description: RightKit adds New File, Copy To, Move To, Open in App and 16 file tools to the Finder context menu. Free and open source, for macOS 26.

hero.lead: RightKit adds New File, Copy To, Move To, Open in App and a full toolbox to the Finder context menu.
hero.charAlt: Riko, the RightKit character, reaching toward a context menu with a white mouse on her shoulder

profile.name: Riko
profile.body: Cheerful, quick handed, and dependable, Riko is your right click helper. Coral hair, a curled ahoge, and her cursor menu hair clip make her easy to spot. The mouse on her shoulder has one coral ear on the viewer's right.

new.label: New File
new.title: Create files right where you click.
new.body: Plain text, Markdown, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JSON, shell scripts and more: 12 types built in, plus any file you save as your own template. Name clashes get a number. Nothing is overwritten.
new.note: Reorder or turn off any type in Settings.
new.imgAlt: Riko pulls a new file out of her hoodie pocket

send.label: Copy To · Move To
send.title: Your folders, one step away.
send.body: Copy To and Move To list the folders you choose. Favorite Folders opens them in Finder with one click. Large jobs show progress and can be cancelled at any time.
send.note: Downloads, Desktop and Documents are set up for you.
send.imgAlt: Riko tosses a file card into a blue folder

open.label: Open in App
open.title: Open it in Terminal or your editor.
open.body: Terminals open the folder. Editors open the item itself. RightKit finds Terminal, Ghostty, Visual Studio Code and Xcode on first launch, and you can add any app.
open.note: Spaces and quotes in paths are handled safely.
open.imgAlt: Riko unlocks an app window with a key-shaped cursor

toolbox.label: Toolbox
toolbox.title: 16 small tools in one submenu.
toolbox.body: Only the commands that fit your selection appear: image tools for images, Dissolve Folder for folders. Turn off or reorder any of them.
toolbox.imgAlt: Riko opens a coral toolbox full of tiny tools

trust.label: Peace of Mind
trust.title: Fast to use. Safe by default.
trust.body: Context menus are easy to misclick, so RightKit takes extra care where it matters.

items.title: Confirms before deleting
items.body: Delete Permanently skips the Trash, so it asks first, with no default button.

items.title: Protected locations
items.body: System folders and your home folder can't be deleted through RightKit.

items.title: Never overwrites
items.body: New, copied and moved items get a number when a name is taken.

items.title: Cancel any time
items.body: Jobs over a second show progress. Cancelling cleans up half-written files.

items.title: Only where you want it
items.body: The menu appears only in folders you authorize. Your home folder is a good start.

items.title: Runs on your Mac
items.body: File operations stay on your Mac. QR codes are generated locally too.

items.title: Shortcuts and Spotlight
items.body: Copy Path, New File, File Hashes, Convert Image, icon sets and more are available as actions.

items.title: QR codes
items.body: Turn selected text into a QR code from the Services menu. Copy it or save it as PNG.

items.title: Translate
items.body: Open selected text in Google Translate or Baidu Translate, in your interface language.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Free and open source. Or chip in a dollar.
pricing.body: Both versions have the same features, and the source code is on GitHub. The direct download is free. The Mac App Store version costs $1, updates through the App Store and helps fund development.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.a: The direct download is free, with every feature, and the source code is on GitHub. The Mac App Store version costs $1, has the same features and updates through the App Store. Buying it supports development.
macOS 26 or later. RightKit is built on the native macOS 26 interface and doesn't support earlier versions.

items.q: I installed it, but the menu doesn't show up.
items.a: Open System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions and turn on the RightKit Finder extension. RightKit's Settings window also shows the extension's status.

items.q: Why is there no menu in some folders?
items.a: The menu only appears in folders you authorize. Authorizing your home folder on first launch is recommended, and you can change it in Settings > General.
No. All file operations happen on your Mac. Only when you choose Translate is the selected text sent to the translation site you picked.
It skips the Trash, so RightKit asks first by default. System folders and your home folder are protected and can't be deleted.

items.q: Can I add my own file templates?
items.a: Yes. Add any file as a template under New File in Settings. RightKit keeps its own copy.
English and Simplified Chinese. It follows your system by default, and you can switch in Settings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: RightKit does not collect, store, or upload any of your personal data. There are no accounts, ads, or usage analytics.

sections.title: Your files
body: Creating, copying, moving, converting images, computing hashes and every other file action happens on your Mac. Your files never leave it. RightKit runs in the App Sandbox and can only access folders you authorize.

sections.title: Settings
body: Templates, favorite folders and preferences are stored only on your Mac. You can remove them when you uninstall RightKit.

sections.title: QR codes
body: QR codes are generated on your Mac. The text is never uploaded.

sections.title: Translation
body: When you use the Google Translate or Baidu Translate service, RightKit puts the selected text in a link and opens that translation website in your default browser. Your browser sends the text to that website, and its privacy policy applies. RightKit itself does not send or keep the text.

sections.title: Update checks (website version only)
body: The website version asks GitHub for the latest version number. The request contains no personal information, but GitHub sees your IP address as with any web request. You can turn off automatic update checks in Settings. The App Store version makes no such request; the App Store handles updates.

sections.title: This website
body: This website is a static site. It uses no cookies and no analytics or tracking scripts. The hosting provider may keep standard access logs for security and operations.

sections.title: Changes and contact
body: If this policy changes, this page and the date above will be updated. For any questions, email contact@yiliang.me.
